en.title: Internal knowledge library for research & tools
en.summary: Feed years of collected research and the therapy tools you actually use into one internal knowledge library the bot can query against your own pain points.
en.whyItWorks: Dramatic automations get attention; quiet internal libraries remove friction from work you already do. Grounding the bot in your research and toolkits makes answers specific to your workflow instead of generic advice.
workflowSteps: Gather the research notes, PDFs, and tool descriptions you already trust.
Create a Grok Bot framed as an internal knowledge librarian—not a public chatbot.
Upload or paste source material in batches; label collections (e.g. research, therapy tools, process notes).
Ask questions against that library only, and require citations back to your materials when possible.
Add a short weekly routine: “Index anything new I sent this week and list gaps.”
en.promptTemplate:
You are my private internal knowledge librarian.

Only use materials I have provided (research notes, therapy tools, process docs). If something is not in the library, say so clearly.

When I ask a question:
1) Answer from the library first.
2) Cite which note/tool you used.
3) Suggest one follow-up question that would deepen the answer.

When I send new material, summarize it in 3 bullets and file it under an existing or new collection label.
en.connectorsAndRoutines: Drop new notes into the bot chat or bot inbox as they appear. On-demand queries for day-to-day work; optional weekly indexing routine for newly added material. No external publish step required.

zh.title: 研究与工具的内部知识库
zh.summary: 把多年积累的研究和你真正在用的疗法/工具资料喂进一个内部知识库，让 Bot 对着你自己的痛点作答。
zh.whyItWorks: 华丽自动化容易吸睛；安静的内部知识库更能消掉日常摩擦。把 Bot 锚定在你自己的研究和工具集上，回答会贴合真实工作流，而不是空泛建议。
workflowSteps: 整理你已经信任的研究笔记、PDF 与工具说明。
创建一个定位为「内部知识馆员」的 Grok Bot，而不是对外聊天机器人。
分批上传或粘贴资料，并打上集合标签（如研究、疗法工具、流程笔记）。
只基于该库提问，并尽量要求回溯到你的原始材料。
加一条简短每周例行：「索引本周新内容并列出缺口」。
zh.promptTemplate:
你是我的私有内部知识馆员。

只使用我提供的材料（研究笔记、疗法工具、流程文档）。库中没有的内容请明确说明。

当我提问时：
1）优先依据知识库作答；
2）注明用到了哪份笔记/工具；
3）再给一个能加深答案的追问。

当我发送新材料时，用 3 条要点摘要，并归入已有或新建集合标签。
zh.connectorsAndRoutines: 有新笔记就丢进 Bot 对话或 Bot 收件箱。日常按需查询；可选每周索引例行处理新增材料。无需对外发布步骤。

source.excerpt:
My Grok Bot use cases aren’t dramatic or sexy. 

But they’ve been game changing for the pain points in my own internal workflow. 

What I’ve built so far:

An internal knowledge library that I fed all the research I’ve collected through the years, as well as therapy tools I use
